1: ## 1. Project Setup
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Create `test-harness/` directory and add `test-harness/reports/` to `.gitignore`
4: - [x] 1.2 Add `tsx` as a dev dependency to the root or a new `test-harness/package.json`
5: - [x] 1.3 Create `test-harness/tsconfig.json` extending the frontend tsconfig, with path aliases to resolve `frontend/src/*`
6: 
7: ## 2. Word List
8: 
9: - [x] 2.1 Create `test-harness/words.ts` with ~40 words in three commented categories: concrete, moderate, abstract — including potato, dog, cat, bird, fish, tree, house, car, rocket, moon, sun, key, sword, hammer, crown, boat, mountain, island, heart, skull, wave, cloud, fire, eye, hand, leaf, spider, butterfly, love, desire, hope, fear, chaos, freedom, death, music, time, joy, anger, peace
10: 
11: ## 3. Runner Script
12: 
13: - [x] 3.1 Create `test-harness/run.ts` skeleton: parse `--run-id` and `--compare` CLI args; auto-assign next `v{N}` ID by scanning `reports/`
14: - [x] 3.2 Implement star catalogue loading: `fs.readFileSync` on `frontend/public/data/stars.json`, parse as `Star[]`
15: - [x] 3.3 Implement fixture loading: for each word, try `fixtures/{word}.json`; if missing POST to `localhost:3001/api/skeleton`, save response, handle connection errors with a clear message
16: - [x] 3.4 Implement matcher invocation: call `match(stars, fixture.skeletons)` from `frontend/src/matcher.ts`; collect score, star count, angular size, Orion%, variant index, patchRA/Dec
17: - [x] 3.5 Implement patch star collection: filter catalogue to stars within `PATCH_RADIUS_DEG` of patchRA/patchDec for each result
18: - [x] 3.6 Write `reports/{runId}/results.json` with run metadata header and per-word result array
19: 
20: ## 4. Report HTML Generation
21: 
22: - [x] 4.1 Implement the report HTML template as a TypeScript string in `run.ts` (or a separate `template.ts`): header section with run ID, date, pass/fail counts
23: - [x] 4.2 Implement word card HTML: bold word heading, score bar with green/amber/red coloring, metric labels (star count, size°), ⚠️ flag for size < 2.5°
24: - [x] 4.3 Implement the inline canvas renderer in the report HTML: load D3 from CDN, use `d3.geoStereographic()` to project patch stars and skeleton points onto each card's canvas; draw faint background stars, brighter matched stars, pale blue constellation edges
25: - [x] 4.4 Embed all result data (including patch stars per word) as a JSON `<script>` tag; confirm the file opens correctly via `file://` with no server
26: 
27: ## 5. Compare Mode
28: 
29: - [x] 5.1 Implement `--compare <idA> <idB>` arg handling: validate both run directories exist, exit with a descriptive error if either is missing
30: - [x] 5.2 Generate `reports/compare-{idA}-{idB}.html`: same grid, each card split left/right with per-run canvas, score, and score delta (colored green for improvement, red for regression)
31: 
32: ## 6. Claude Skill
33: 
34: - [x] 6.1 Create `.claude/commands/test-constellations.md` with the skill definition: argument parsing, pre-flight fixture check logic, runner invocation, Playwright screenshot steps, summary table format
35: - [x] 6.2 Document the Playwright steps in the skill: use MCP plugin if available, else `npx playwright`; full-page screenshot first, then individual screenshots for red-score cards
36: - [x] 6.3 Document the compare review flow in the skill: open compare HTML, full-page screenshot, list top 5 most-improved and top 5 most-degraded words
37: 
38: ## 7. Validation
39: 
40: - [x] 7.1 Run the harness end-to-end: start `npm run dev:local` in `lambda/`, run `npx tsx test-harness/run.ts`, confirm `reports/v1/results.json` and `report.html` are generated
41: - [ ] 7.2 Open `report.html` in a browser and confirm all cards render correctly with canvases, score bars, and metrics
42: - [x] 7.3 Run compare mode: `npx tsx test-harness/run.ts --compare v1 v1` (self-compare, all deltas should be 0); confirm compare HTML renders
43: - [ ] 7.4 Invoke `/test-constellations` in a Claude session and confirm the full skill flow works end-to-end
